issues.where: entire planet limb (crops A, B, D, G, H, I; also image-01.png and image-03.png crops J, K, L, O, P, Q)
issues.what: the globe terminates in a hard circular cutout edge surrounded by a uniform 2D outer-glow halo that wraps continuously around the unlit night-side limb
issues.fix: replace the uniform 2D layer glow with sun-angle-dependent volumetric limb scattering that softens the sunlit horizon transition and drops to zero on the dark side

issues.where: lower-right limb (crop I; also image-03.png crop P)
issues.what: a doubled edge runs along the lower-right horizon, showing an inner orange-tan arc separated by a dark band from a second outer glowing rim line
issues.fix: eliminate the concentric dark gap and outer ring artifact so the cloud deck attenuates smoothly once toward the limb

issues.where: sunlit cloud deck and right vortex (crops A, B, F, G; also image-03.png crop K)
issues.what: at native size the clouds look like sculpted impasto paint and rocky crusts rather than gas, with crunchy pixelated stippling, serrated comb-like ridge artifacts, and solid rope-like vortex coils
issues.fix: replace the synthetic painterly/AI surface texture with multi-scale gaseous cloud layers and soft volumetric self-shadowing without serrated high-frequency noise

issues.where: lower shadowed hemisphere and terminator (crop P; also image-02.png crops D, H, I)
issues.what: surface detail becomes blurry, smeared, and airbrushed across the dark side, with stretched streaks running parallel to the lower-right limb and stray bright orange spots inside deep shadow
issues.fix: preserve crisp 3D-projected cloud structure across the terminator and dark hemisphere with physically consistent shadow falloff and no limb-parallel texture stretching

issues.where: sunlit upper and upper-right limb (crop G; also image-03.png crops K, L)
issues.what: highlights clip to a flat, washed-out pale yellow band along the outer sunlit disc before stopping abruptly at the circular edge
issues.fix: use smooth highlight tone-mapping rolloff so cloud contrast and limb brightening grade naturally without flat clipping

issues.where: limb glare and dark-limb edge (crops D, G, H; also image-03.png crops K, O, Q)
issues.what: crisp background stars sit unattenuated inside the blazing sunlit atmospheric glare and directly on the lower-left limb rim
issues.fix: mask stars completely behind the planet's opaque atmosphere radius and attenuate nearby stars beneath optical bloom and limb haze

issues.where: starfield sky crops (crops C, E; also image-03.png crops M, R and image-04.png crops S, T, U, V, W, X)
issues.what: most faint and mid-brightness stars are hard un-anti-aliased 1x1 square pixels that look blocky at native size and will shimmer in motion
issues.fix: render stars with a soft sub-pixel Gaussian or Airy point-spread function (around 1.5 to 2 pixels FWHM) instead of isolated single pixels
